spec2def(watchdog.sys watchdog.spec)

# watchdog.sys is all Rust (watchdog-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/watchdog-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# watchdog.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/watchdog-rust/src/watchdog/watchdog.rs)
add_cargo_module(watchdog watchdog-cargo watchdog.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE watchdog-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
